simple.meaning: סָכַן (çâkan) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be familiar with; by implication, to minister to, be serviceable to, to cherish , be customary.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 12 times across Numbers, 1 Kings, Job, Psalms, Isaiah, beginning at Numbers 22:30. Its contexts include family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סָכַן (H5532).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: סָכַן (çâkan) / H5532 is traced through Numbers 22:30, 1 Kings 1:2, 1 Kings 1:4, Job 15:3 as a generated source-based concept entry.
